title: Mute Review
description: What a blind reviewer returns after reading the contact sheets of a render without the sound (skills/meta/mute-review.md). Checked by lib/mute_review.py against the story beats and the sheet index: a beat without a verdict is not_checked, a verdict citing a sheet or cell that does not exist is rejected, an 'absent' beat blocks.

reviewer.description: Independence declaration. All three must be false for the review to count.

observed.description: What is visible in the cited cells, written before the verdict.

who_does_what.description: Each action attributed to the character (or object) that performs it, as seen.

verdict.description: lisible: reads as expected. partiel: there but ambiguous, too fast or weak. absent: not visible. contradicts: readable but different from expected (who does it, which side, which direction) -- REQUIRED whenever who_does_what or the side/direction diverges from the beat's expected text.

between_cells_risk.description: Set when a gesture may fall between two cells, so 'absent' might be a sampling artefact.

other_findings.description: Story problems seen outside the listed beats (advisory).
